definition: Conflict-minerals profile: due-diligence declarations for tin, tantalum, tungsten and gold (3TG) per Regulation (EU) 2017/821, attaching by composition and origin facts

custody.note: bag-and-tag upstream chains claim identity preservation; smelter/refiner stages claim mass balance over the documented period; the declared model is part of every claim

manifest.issuing_role: importer (Union due-diligence duty holder under Reg (EU) 2017/821); smelter/refiner attestations enter as lens-scoped stamps

legal_basis.citation: Union importers' due-diligence obligations for 3TG; Annex I (OECD five-step framework), Annex II (CAHRA risk provisions)
third edition (2016), five-step framework and annex II risks
legal_basis.instrument: OECD Due Diligence Guidance for Responsible Supply Chains of Minerals from Conflict-Affected and High-Risk Areas
Responsible Minerals Initiative — Responsible Minerals Assurance Process (RMAP)

manifest.notes: The profile demonstrates cross-axial stacking: it composes with jurisdiction profiles (EU duty) on the same identity without redefining any data element. The Regulation applies from 1 January 2021; the effective_from carries that legal timing.

triggers.description: subject contains Sn, Ta, W or Au above the Regulation's mass-fraction or import-volume thresholds
